notes.title: Chubziki 0.0.11
notes.content:
[h3]Hello!

Sometimes ball didn't trigger the button.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Auto-Saves for player position.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced build size.[/p][/*][*][p]Rebaked garage lighting.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]💡 [b]Chubzik improvements[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Chubziks now leave different corpses depending on their armor type.[/p][/*][*][p]Chubzik corpses now turn grey and slightly move undrground. Like in previous versions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug when chubziks wouldn't start fighting before player car stops once.[/p][/*][*][p]Slowed down how pikeman chubziks rotate.[/p][/*][*][p]Chubziks movement speed now depends on chubziks actual weight, instead of being a fixed value. notes.title: Chubziki 0.0.9
notes.content:
[p]Dear players![/p][p]We’re excited to bring you update [b]0.0.9[/b]! This patch is packed with two brand-new battles, a ton of fresh Chubziks variety, major quality-of-life improvements, and dozens of bug fixes. Dive in and check out what’s new:[/p][h2]⚔️ Battles[/h2][list][*][p][b]Reworked and rebalanced every battle on the map[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Added a brand new foresters battle, who protect the entrance to the market[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Added a new boss-like battle against dozens elite chubziks and 11 barracks that spawn new chubziks![/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Market Gate Shield[/b]: Interactive shield around the Market entrance button that dissolves after 10 seconds (resets if you remain on the pad).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Added two new equipment items for your car![/b] 
1. Chained morgenshtern
2. Hook[/p][/*][/list][h2]🐾 Chubziki Enhancements[/h2][list][*][p][b]New Chubziki Variants[/b]: Integrated a fresh model, eye props, and armor pieces. Now there are 7 levels of armor available for any chubzik! They all have different health, speed and weight.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Stand-Up Animation[/b]: Chubziki now get up from the ground with a smooth animation instead of teleporting upright.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Melee Combat Overhaul[/b]: Revamped MeleeAttackPattern logic and added new weapons (mace, axe, sword) for close-quarters action. Every new weapon has unique characteristics.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sniper AI Retreat[/b]: Sniper Chubziki dash to a random cover point after each shot.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Barrier Equipment Buff[/b]: “Barrier” gear now blocks incoming projectiles with a 50% chance.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dust Explosion VFX[/b]: Enjoy a satisfying burst of dust whenever a Chubziki is defeated.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ragdoll Fixes[/b]: Eliminated null-reference crashes in the ragdoll bone container.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Pool Return Stability[/b]: Fixed errors when recycling Chubziki instances back into the object pool.[/p][/*][*][p][b]NavMesh Generation Tweak[/b]: Chubziki NavMeshes are now only built when they’re grounded, preventing off-field spawns.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Respawn Reset[/b]: Chubziki no longer retain last-session positions—they respawn fresh each battle.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Code Refactor[/b]: Cleaned up and modularized Chubziki AI code for better maintainability.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Eye Assets Ready[/b]: All new Chubziki eye textures and meshes uploaded—awaiting final integration.[/p][/*][/list][h2]🎵 Audio[/h2][list][*][p][b]12+ New Sound Effects[/b]![/p][/*][/list][h2]🎨 UI & VFX[/h2][list][*][p][b]Unified UI Styling[/b]: Menus and HUD elements now share a cohesive, minimalist look.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Spark Particles on Equip[/b]: Equipping gear nudges your vehicle into place with a shower of sparks.[/p][/*][/list][h2]🏎️ Races & 🎳 Bowling[/h2][list][*][p][b]Ordered Checkpoints[/b]: Race checkpoints only activate once you’ve passed the previous one.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Replay Friendly[/b]: Races and bowling can be replayed freely—rewards granted only on first completion.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Race Build Fixes[/b]: Stability and timing tweaks to ensure smooth race runs.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bowling Boundary Fix[/b]: Crossing the red line no longer crashes or locks up the game.[/p][/*][/list][h2]🛠️ Architecture, Stability, Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p][b]Battle Restart Stability[/b]: Chubziki no longer freeze when restarting battles multiple times. Although they might freeze sometimes before you stop the car. We are fixing it[/p][/*][*][p][b]Quest Spawn Bug[/b]: Fixed quests referencing uninitialized Chubziki instances that caused game hangs.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Duplicate Variable Cleanup[/b]: Removed redundant minimalStunTime declarations.[/p][/*][*][p][b]VisibleActorsManager Fix[/b]: Squashed errors causing actor-visibility glitches.[/p][/*][*][p]And many other perfomance improvements, crash and bug fixes and etc.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Delayed Unloading[/b]: Locations now unload 15 seconds after you leave, smoothing transition hitches.[/p][/*][*][p][b]General Optimizations[/b]: Performance tweaks and memory-use improvements across all regions.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Thank you for your incredible feedback and support—keep it coming! We can’t wait to see what you think of 0.0.9.[/p][p]— The Goodwin Games Team[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565898/8047dfe8999aa1293a6aec568ef85fd06186f803.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Chubziki 0.0.6 - “Attention to Comfort”
notes.content:
Dear players,

This update is all about improving your experience by fixing what interrupts your flow, polishing rough edges, and laying down the groundwork for bigger maps ahead.
Many little things make a big difference.


[h2]🔧 Stability & Bug Fixes[/h2]
[h3]🛑 Menu Stability[/h3]
Fixed multiple errors when exiting to the main menu — whether in battle or not.
Fixed crash when exiting Play Mode in gameplay scenes.

[h3]⏸ Transition-Safe Pausing[/h3]
You can no longer open the pause menu during scene transitions. This prevents animation interruptions and ensures smooth scene change.

[h3]⚠️ Smart Warning System[/h3]
The system that warns you about leaving quest zones or being underwater, allowing you to have some time to react. No more interruptive popups!

[h3]♻️ Code Cleanup[/h3]
Reduced duplicate code in Chubzik AI, improving performance and maintainability.

[h3]📦 Actor Spawn Batching[/h3]
Dynamic objects are now loaded in small batches (2 per frame) to reduce fps drops during location loading in open world.


[h2]🏗 World & Visuals[/h2]
[h3]🏘 Improved Market Gates[/h3]
Visual and structural updates to the market district’s gates — more unique, readable, and satisfying to approach.

[h3]🎯 Projectile Outline[/h3]
We’ve refined how enemy projectiles are rendered during gameplay, they have a clear outline and a slight glimmer now. This makes dodging and reacting in bullet-heavy scenarios much easier.

[h3]🧷 Upgrade UI Improvements[/h3]
Upgrade descriptions are now clearly labeled (“Max Speed”, “Engine Power”) — no more guessing.

[h3]🔒 Equipment Save Fixes[/h3]
Resolved bugs where unlocked equipment didn’t save between sessions.

[h3]🔧 Environment adjustments[/h3]
Slightly changed positions of some objects, mainy trees, for a more fun friving experience. Also made that thin bridge in the start much wider.

As always, your feedback shapes what comes next. Tell us what works, what doesn’t, and what you’d love to see.

Thanks for playing,
— The Goodwin Games Team

notes.title: Chubziki 0.0.5 - is now available!
notes.content:
[h3]Dear players,
This new update is called "Saved & Procted" and brings to you some fixes, improvements and two new features![/h3]

[h2]🔐 Major feature: Save-System![/h2]
We’ve introduced a full auto-save system that remembers everything:
Completed quests, quest object states, vehicle upgrades, unlocked equipment,
player’s location and other.
Your progress is now saved automatically and loaded when you return to the game!
You are able to have multiple save-profiles to play with friends or experiment.

[h2]🪖 Major feature: Armored Chubziks[/h2]
Chubziks now come with armor variations and modular body parts (head, torso, weapon). This not only improves diversity but also optimized how they’re rendered to improve performance in large battles.
They also have different weight and move speed depending on armor.

[h2]🛠️ Other improvements & fixes[/h2]
- Vehicle control improvements: Air control, upgrades balance, improved wheels traction with ground
- Fixed a bug where Chubziks remained floating after leaving and re-entering battle zones.
- Adjusted garage camera behavior for better customization experience.
- Equipment save bugs fixed: all unlocks now persist properly.
- Reworked the upgrade popup texts for clarity ("Max Speed", "Engine Power").
- Removed unused code and redundant logic across the project.
- Changed damage and speed for projectiles

We hope that you will enjoy this new version. Don't forget to share your opinions with us, so we could make the game better!

Best wishes, 
Goodwin Games team
